title: Pass the Pattern · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Pass the Pattern · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a three-action pattern of gentle claps and taps. The first player performs the first action, the partner the second, and the first player the third. The pair completes the selected pattern in order. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Pass the Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The pair completes the selected pattern in order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The pair completes the selected pattern in order.
